text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Median income per day (before tax) 1968 to 2024
Level of income per day below which 50% of the population falls. This data is adjusted for inflation and
differences in living costs between countries. Income here is measured before taxes and benefits.

tspan.tspan: This data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Income has been equivalized.
